meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把解析好的结构化文档按你的意图生成四色卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡。每张卡片带来源与生成方式，无来源的事实会标注「无来源」，不直接下断言。
howto.when: 当你要把解析后的文档做成可溯源的分析卡片时触发；由通政司 Worker 主调用生成蓝卡与绿卡，黄卡交监察院复核，红卡由丞相府补全，四卡统一经太史阁留痕。

say.text: 把这份解析文档做成四色卡片，蓝卡要带来源
say.note: 产出事实/解释/风险/行动四张卡片

say.text: 给这份研报补一张风险黄卡和行动红卡
say.note: 黄卡经监察院复核，红卡由丞相府补全

say.text: 跑 extract 阶段，先把蓝卡事实抽出来

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a parsed document plus your intent into four cards: blue facts, green explanation, yellow risks, red actions. Each card carries its source and generation method; facts without sources are marked "no source" instead of asserted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want source-traceable analysis cards from a parsed document. The Tongzhengsi worker generates blue and green cards, Jichayuan reviews yellow, Chengxiangfu completes red; all four are logged by Taishige.

say_en.text: Turn this parsed document into four cards, blue card with sources
Add a yellow risk card and a red action card for this report
say_en.note: Yellow reviewed by Jichayuan, red by Chengxiangfu

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull out blue fact cards first
